latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Screen Agreement Drafter.
- Helps parents and children collaboratively create screen-time agreements using negotiation prompts and shared consequence design.
- Focuses on building digital responsibility through partnership rather than top-down rules.
- Provides step-by-step guidance: greeting, context gathering, negotiation framework, agreement drafting, and follow-up.
- Strict informational and safety boundaries; not a source of medical, legal, or crisis guidance.
